capability.question: does the progressive path decode P and B pictures

artifact.reported: dot crawl at the left edge and thin vertical lines after each colour band
artifact.therefore: not prediction drift and not P/B related
artifact.raster: picture measured at 720x480 placed 1:1 at offset (40,60) in the 800x600 diagnostic raster, so no resampling is involved

measurement.transition: yellow to blue at reference x=359
measurement.note: hardware inserts one blended column that the reference decoder never produces

artifact.reference_result: clean transition under both, so the difference is not the reference upsampling choice
artifact.mister_ini: absent from /media/fat, so a system video filter is unlikely
artifact.leading_hypothesis: horizontal chroma upsampling in the core 4:2:0 to RGB path interpolates where the reference replicates
artifact.not_established: whether that interpolation is correct for the intended chroma siting, and whether anything else in the write or read path contributes

method_note: This is the first pixel comparison of actual playback output in this project. Screenshots at 800x600 capture the core output before the HDMI scaler, so they can be compared against an FFmpeg decode of the same frame.
